notes.title: Launch Update on Windows
notes.content:
Spermination will now first try using your Java installation, just in case you have a 32-bit system or a newer version of the Java runtime. If no Java version is detected, the included 64-bit Java will be used.

If the included Java version doesn't work for you, or if your Java version is outdated, install the latest here:

http://www.java.com/getjava

EDIT: Also should have fixed a Linux library loading issue.

EDIT 11/16/2015: Fixed a "GUI fragment shader" crash!

EDIT 11/17/2015: Updated jMonkeyVR, better VR & Vive support & performance!

notes.title: Speed & Intensity Update!
notes.content:
You've never shot your load with this much speed & intensity! Tighter controls, faster swimming, more powerups & rebalanced mechanics all included in v1.21!

You may take a little more damage, but now there are health pickups to find. Weapons use a little less energy, are a little more effective, and energy pickups will supercharge you to make more use of them!

Difficulty has been tweaked too, to. Enjoy!

Also updated Java for the Windows version.
